profile.name: Anjaneya Kariguli
profile.intro: Passionate developer, always eager to build real-world applications, solve problems and learn new technologies.
about: I am a final-year B.Tech student in Computer Science and Technology at Presidency University, Bengaluru, graduating in 2027. Most of my projects are full stack: a React interface, a Java backend and a MySQL database.

I learn by building. A task dashboard, an expense tracker and a placement management system each taught me something different, from managing state in the browser to designing tables that stay consistent as an app grows. I also enjoy working through programming problems and data structures.

I am aiming for a role as a software engineer, where I can work on real systems, write code that other people can maintain, and take a feature from design to deployment. NCC has taught me discipline and how to work well in a team, and I bring both to group work.

projects.title: Personal Task Management Dashboard
projects.description: A dashboard for planning daily tasks. Create, edit and delete tasks, in a layout that works on phones as well as desktops.

projects.title: Income and Expense Tracker
projects.description: Record income and expenses to see where the money goes. A React interface talks to a Spring Boot REST API that stores everything in MySQL.

projects.title: Student Placement Management System
projects.description: A system for managing student records and placement activity in one place, built with Java, Spring Boot and MySQL.

projects.title: GAN-Based Plant Leaf Disease Detection
projects.description: Uses a conditional DCGAN to generate extra leaf images, which expands the training data for a plant disease detection model.
